استجهلت (form X)
# اِسْتَجْهَلْتُ (istajhaltu) /is.tad͡ʒ.hal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# اِسْتَجْهَلْتَ (istajhalta) /is.tad͡ʒ.hal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# اِسْتَجْهَلْتِ (istajhalti) /is.tad͡ʒ.hal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# اِسْتَجْهَلَتْ (istajhalat)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
